candidate.definition_en: A professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign army or private military force.
candidate.explanation_ar: مرتزق، وهو جندي محترف يقاتل لصالح دولة أو جهة أجنبية مقابل المال دون اعتبار لأي قضية وطنية.

senses.definition_en: A professional soldier hired to serve in a foreign army or private military force.
senses.definition_ar: جندي مأجور يقاتل في سبيل المال لصالح جهة أو دولة أجنبية.
examples: He was accused of being a mercenary.
A mercenary fights for financial gain rather than national loyalty.
The rebel leader hired an experienced mercenary to train his recruits.
He was accused of being a mercenary.
A mercenary fights for financial gain rather than national loyalty.
The rebel leader hired an experienced mercenary to train his recruits.
candidate.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة Merchant (تاجر)؛ فالمرتزق (mercenary) يتاجر بسلاحه ويحارب من أجل المال فقط كأنه صفقة تجارية.
